# PDF visual inspection

All 17 rendered pages were inspected in a contact sheet; the global theorem,
validation table, lattice example, cut-chart appendix, and reflowed literature
page were also inspected at higher resolution.

- title, abstract, and contents are centered and legible;
- displayed equations remain within the text block;
- the validation table fits without crowding;
- no clipping, overlap, broken glyph, or black box is visible;
- bibliography indentation and page numbering are consistent;
- final-page whitespace is acceptable for the bibliography ending.

The final strict build reports zero overfull boxes.
